$comment: Issue #535 (saved views of a sprint's tasks, with filters on verdict, risk and producer) written as a La Fabrique specification, in the PO's shape: requirements with criteria in Given/When/Then form, read as EARS event-driven requirements (WHEN <trigger> THE SYSTEM SHALL <response>), as Kiro's requirements.md does; design only, nothing taken from Kiro's code. Only the narrow core is specified: the filter, its agreement with the board and the views' access. The list layout and custom columns (#437) are left to a later specification. Post it with POST /v1/specifications, adding the company_id (scripts/self_host/self_host.py does); the ids are assigned by spec_check.normalize. This file specifies the issue; it does not implement it.
title: Saved views of a sprint's tasks, filtered on the evidence
summary: A Manager asks questions about the evidence (every refuted delivery this month, the tasks waiting for a person by producer, the tasks covering REQ-3) and the kanban board cannot answer them. A filter is a JSON tree of conditions over an allowlist of fields, evaluated on the server from the task projections; a saved view keeps a filter with its layout, for its author or for the company. From issue #535; the design follows Plane's IssueView (AGPL-3.0-only, design only, no code taken).

requirements.title: Filter expressions over an allowlist of fields
requirements.description: A filter is a tree of conditions (field, operator, value) under AND groups. The fields come from a server-side allowlist: status, verdict, risk tier, producer, assignee role, rework count, waits for a person, covers REQ, sprint. Any other field is refused, never ignored.

criteria.given: a filter with one condition on a field outside the allowlist, such as title
criteria.then: the response is 422 and names the field, and no task is evaluated

criteria.given: a sprint with one blocked task waiting for a person, one blocked task that is not, and one done task
criteria.when: the filter is an AND group of status = blocked and waits_for_person = true
criteria.then: only the first task is returned

requirements.title: The filtered list agrees with the board
requirements.description: The filter is evaluated from the same projections the board reads (TaskRecord), so the board and a view never disagree about the same tasks.

criteria.given: a sprint whose board lists three tasks as done
criteria.when: GET /v1/tasks is called with the filter status = done and the sprint's id
criteria.then: it returns exactly those three tasks, the count the board shows

requirements.title: Saved views, private or for the company
requirements.description: A SavedView is company-scoped and keeps the filters, group_by, order_by, layout (board or list), visible columns, access (private or company) and locked. Each person's display preferences are kept apart from the view.

criteria.given: a private view saved by one member
criteria.when: another member of the company lists the views
criteria.then: the private view is not listed

criteria.when: a Viewer tries to change its filters
criteria.then: the response is 403 and the view is unchanged

quality.target: a filter over 5,000 tasks answers in under 300 ms at the 95th percentile, within the page budget of docs/ux/performance_usability_benchmark.md
0 conditions evaluated on a field outside the allowlist; a view's access is checked on every read, by the company role
a saved view whose filter names a field no longer in the allowlist is reported invalid when read: 0 partial results
the filter controls meet WCAG 2.2 AA: each has a label and is reachable by keyboard, with 0 serious or critical axe findings

constraints: Plane is AGPL-3.0-only: its design may be studied, no code is taken
The filter is evaluated from the task projections; the only new table is the saved view
The frontend follows the layer rule of issue #519
